name: Night Owl
description: Night Owl is a compact dual-lane automated filament changer for Klipper printers. It is functionally a smaller variant of Box Turtle, using the same lane-based architecture where each lane has its own dedicated stepper motor. Unlike Box Turtle, Night Owl does not include electric respoolers and uses an off-the-shelf FYSETC ERB 2.0 board (RP2040-based) rather than a custom PCB. Multiple Night Owl units can be chained together via the AFC software for additional filament capacity.
features: Same AFC software capabilities as Box Turtle
Uses off-the-shelf FYSETC ERB 2.0 MCU board
CAN bus or serial USB connectivity
Multiple units can be chained for additional capacity
